_about: Robustness: confusing single-turn questions and a scripted multi-turn conversation in which every turn sends the real earlier answers as history. Motivated by: Laban et al. 2025 (multi-turn degradation), FreshQA (false premises), Shi et al. 2023 (distraction). Expected strings were checked against the extracted text of each document. `none` lists strings that must NOT appear.
